# Why run closed-loop sim-to-data filtering after kinematic retargeting of human motions?

> **Current answer:** In H2O's H1 pipeline, a privileged motion imitator tracks every retargeted motion in closed loop and removes failed sequences. This exposes labels made infeasible by contact, inertia, or controller bandwidth more effectively than kinematic thresholds alone. It is a useful pre-training data gate, but passing it does not guarantee safety on another robot or on hardware.
